appraisal_events.evidence: The duchesse de Guermantes, once hesitant, has decidedly taken Rachel as a friend; Rachel, now a celebrated actress, recites at the princesse de Guermantes's, and it is said that Rachel, not the princesse, is really the one receiving there.
appraisal_events.explanation: Rachel, formerly a disreputable actress, is publicly and materially elevated by her new intimacy with the duchesse de Guermantes and her effective hosting role at the princesse de Guermantes's party.

appraisal_events.evidence: Invited guests, including her own longtime faithful, all defect to the Guermantes reception; hours pass and no one comes; the sole guest present keeps checking the time and eventually leaves too, so the tea becomes 'un repas funéraire' finished off as 'les gâteaux funéraires.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The dying Berma is collectively deserted in favor of the rival, Rachel-graced gathering, a public abandonment the narrator frames as tragic and decisive rather than as a minor slight.

status_effects.explanation: Rachel's rise from disreputable actress to intimate of the duchesse de Guermantes and effective hostess at the princesse de Guermantes's is a standing witnessed and remarked upon by society at large.

The 'nouvelles générations' conclude from her friendship with Rachel that the duchesse was never truly of the first rank, though the narrator elsewhere frames such conclusions as partly a misreading, so this discredit is registered with lower confidence.
The mass defection of her guests to the rival gathering is a public snub, witnessed and dwelt on by the narrator, that visibly diminishes Berma's remaining social pull even as her own fame endures.

ambiguities: The narrator offers several competing explanations (mediocrity, boredom-driven fantasy, or a freedom from ordinary snobbery) for why the duchesse now befriends Rachel, and separately shows that some onlookers misread her use of royal protocol formulas as evidence of low standing; the overall direction and reliability of the duchesse's reputation shift is therefore left genuinely uncertain.
